query:
WITH RECURSIVE cte(ref,parent, level) AS
        (
            SELECT  ref, parent, 1 AS level
            FROM  collection
                WHERE parent IS NULL AND type = ?
        UNION ALL
            SELECT  c.ref, c.parent, level + 1 AS LEVEL
            FROM  collection c
            INNER JOIN  cte
                ON  cte.ref = c.parent
        )
        SELECT cte.ref, cte.parent FROM cte ORDER BY level
